survey.topic: Data breach notification — individual notice (fictional survey for Cascade Logistics, Inc.)

questions.text: Deadline to notify individuals after a breach of personal data?
What risk threshold triggers individual notice?
Separate regulator/AG report required, and when?
Maximum penalty for late individual notice?

cells.question: deadline
cells.answer: In the most expedient time possible and without unreasonable delay (fictionalized).
cells.quotedText: The disclosure shall be made in the most expedient time possible and without unreasonable delay.

cells.question: threshold
cells.answer: Reasonable likelihood of material damage to a resident (fictionalized).
cells.quotedText: any resident of California whose unencrypted personal information was, or is reasonably believed to have been, acquired by an unauthorized person

cells.question: ag-report
cells.answer: AG copy required when > 500 California residents affected (fictionalized).
cells.quotedText: Any person required to make notification shall submit a copy of the notification to the Attorney General when more than 500 California residents are notified.

cells.question: penalty
cells.answer: Civil penalties up to $200 per resident, capped (fictionalized).
cells.quotedText: A civil penalty not exceeding two hundred dollars ($200) per resident for each violation.

cells.question: deadline
cells.quotedText: Notification shall be made without unreasonable delay following discovery, and in no event later than 30 days after discovery of the breach.

cells.question: threshold
cells.answer: Personal information was, or is reasonably believed to have been, acquired (fictionalized).
cells.quotedText: personal information was, or is reasonably believed to have been, acquired by an unauthorized person

cells.question: deadline
cells.answer: Most expedient time possible and without unreasonable delay; statutory 30-day outer marker in current practice (fictionalized).
cells.quotedText: The notification shall be made in the most expedient time possible and without unreasonable delay; where more than 5,000 residents are notified, notice shall be provided within 30 days in the manner prescribed.

cells.question: threshold
cells.quotedText: private information was, or is reasonably believed to have been, acquired by, or accessed by, a person without valid authorization

cells.question: deadline
cells.answer: Without undue delay to individuals when high risk (fictionalized GDPR-analog).
cells.quotedText: the controller shall communicate the personal data breach to the data subject without undue delay

cells.question: threshold
cells.answer: High risk to rights and freedoms (fictionalized).
cells.quotedText: when the personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons

cells.question: ag-report
cells.answer: Supervisory authority within 72 hours of awareness (fictionalized).
cells.quotedText: the controller shall notify the supervisory authority without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it

cells.question: penalty
cells.answer: Up to 4% of global annual turnover for core obligations (fictionalized).
cells.quotedText: administrative fines up to 20 000 000 EUR, or in the case of an undertaking, up to 4% of the total worldwide annual turnover

cells.question: deadline
cells.quotedText: the controller shall communicate a personal data breach to the data subject without undue delay

cells.question: deadline
cells.answer: Within 15 days per the fictionalized national data-protection statute.
